claim: Dutch Square is the heart of Malacca's UNESCO core; Stadthuys is the oldest Dutch building in the East and Christ Church (1753) is an active Anglican church.
quote: Stadthuys ... the oldest Dutch building in the East ... Christ Church, built in 1753 ... remains an active Anglican place of worship.

claim: Dutch Square's red terracotta colonial buildings are among the most photographed spots in Malacca and the heart of the World Heritage site.
quote: one of the most photographed locations in Malacca and is the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage Site.

claim: The Stadthuys dates from c.1650 as the Dutch governors' residence and now houses the History and Ethnography Museum.
quote: the oldest Dutch building in the East, dating from 1650 CE ... now houses the History and Ethnography Museum.

claim: Christ Church (1753) and the 1886 Tan Beng Swee clock tower are landmark photo spots on the Red Square.
quote: Christ Church: Built in 1753 ... The Malacca Clock Tower ... built in 1886 by a local philanthropist, Tan Jiak Kim.

claim: St Paul's Church was built in 1521 by the Portuguese and is the oldest church in Southeast Asia, now a ruin.
quote: St Paul's Church is the oldest church in Southeast Asia ... built as a Catholic chapel in 1521.

claim: Porta de Santiago is the lone surviving gate of the A Famosa fortress, bears the Dutch ANNO 1670 inscription, and St Paul's is a 5-10 min walk up the hill; both free.
quote: the tiny gate called the Porta de Santiago ... logo "ANNO 1670" ... a 5 to 10 minutes walk through the stairway.

claim: St Paul's Church ruins are free to enter and open-air.
quote: Church of Saint Paul, Malacca Tickets ... Opening Hours.

claim: St Paul's Hill church is the oldest church in Malaysia and once held the body of St Francis Xavier.
quote: St Paul Church Melaka - Oldest Church in Malaysia.

claim: Cheng Hoon Teng is the oldest functioning Chinese temple in Malaysia, founded 1645, with free entry.
quote: the oldest functioning temple in the country.

claim: Visitors to Cheng Hoon Teng should dress modestly and remove shoes; no ticket required.
quote: dress respectfully, covering shoulders and knees ... removing shoes before entering.

claim: Cheng Hoon Teng opens 07:00-18:00 Mon-Thu and Sat, and 07:00-20:30 Fri and Sun.
Official Baba Nyonya museum hours are 10:00-16:15 weekdays (except Tue) and 10:00-16:45 weekends; RM100 surcharge for costume.
quote: 10:00am-4:15pm (Weekdays, except Tuesday) ... surcharge of RM100 for visitors dressed in costume.

claim: The Baba & Nyonya Heritage Museum is a preserved Straits-Chinese townhouse with guided tours of ~1-1.5 hours.
quote: Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum - Opulent Townhouse in Melaka.

claim: Baba Nyonya admission ~RM18 adult; guided tour recommended; groups over 10 should book ~1 month ahead.
quote: RM18 for adults ... If you are a group of more than 10 people you should book your tour at least one month in advance.

claim: Masjid Selat Melaka sits on man-made Pulau Melaka, appears to float at high tide, and is best at sunset.
quote: this stunning "floating mosque" appears to hover above the sea during high tide.

claim: The Straits Mosque opened in 2006 and lights up beautifully after dark.
quote: Officially opened to the public in 2006 ... After dark, the mosque will light up.

claim: The mosque opens ~09:00-21:00 except prayer times; free with donations; modest dress and headscarf required.
quote: open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, except during main prayer times ... modest clothing is required.

claim: Jonker Street (Jalan Hang Jebat) is Chinatown's busiest street; weekends are most crowded.
quote: Jonker Street - All You SHOULD Know Before Going.

claim: The Jonker night market runs Fri/Sat/Sun from 18:00; no weekday market.
quote: operates on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from 18:00.

claim: Jonker night market is free, runs to ~midnight, and is best entered ~18:30 before food sells out.
quote: no entrance fee ... best time to visit is shortly after its opening, at around 6:30 pm.

claim: Skip-the-line e-tickets exist for the Melaka River Cruise but are optional.
quote: Melaka River Cruise E-Ticket - 2026.

claim: The river cruise is a 45-min 9-km loop, runs 09:00-23:00 every ~30 min, foreign adult ~RM30, night is best.
quote: scenic 45-minute river cruise ... 9-kilometer route ... foreign adults are around RM30 ... operates daily from 9 AM to 11 PM.

claim: Official Melaka River Cruise ticketing site lists departures and night cruise options.
quote: Melaka River Cruise.

claim: The Maritime Museum is a full-size replica of the 1511 galleon Flor de la Mar; three museums in one; open 09:00-17:30; ~RM10 foreigners.
quote: full sized replica of Flor De La Mar ... open daily from 9am to 5.30pm ... RM10 for foreigners.

claim: The Flor de la Mar was a Portuguese galleon that sank in the Strait of Malacca in 1511.
quote: Maritime Museum (Malaysia).

claim: Muzium Samudera (Flor de la Mar) ticketing and opening hours for 2026.
quote: Muzium Samudera (Flor de La Mar) Tickets [2026].

claim: Best time to visit Melaka is the dry months of April, May and October; hot and humid year-round ~30C.
quote: April, May and October during the dry season, are the best time to visit Melaka.

claim: Shoulder seasons are April-May and October-November; SW monsoon late May-Sep, NE monsoon Nov-Mar.
quote: drier "shoulder seasons" are in April-May and October-November.

claim: The NE monsoon (Nov-Mar) brings the rainiest, cooler weather to the west coast.
quote: Malaysia | weather by month - climate - seasons.

claim: Klebang Beach is ~15 min from central Malacca with sand dunes and famous coconut shake; muddy Strait-side beach.
quote: Klebang Beach is about a 15-minute drive from the center of Malacca.

claim: Klebang Original Coconut Shake is RM5-8 a cup; stall ~12:30-18:30 (Fri from 14:00).
quote: MYR 5 to 8 a cup ... Business Hours: 12:30 PM to 6:30 PM daily, with a later start at 2:00 PM on Fridays.

claim: Pulau Besar is an island ~8 km off Melaka reached by ferry from Jeti Anjung Umbai, a quiet low-key day-trip.
quote: Pulau Besar is an actual island about 8 kilometers off the coast of Melaka ... ferry from Jeti Anjung Umbai.

claim: ECB publishes the official euro reference rate for the Malaysian ringgit.
quote: Malaysian ringgit (MYR) - European Central Bank.

claim: In 2026, 1 EUR averaged about 4.76 MYR (MYR 1 about 0.21 EUR).
quote: 1 Euro = 4.7635 Malaysian Ringgit.

claim: Sri Poyatha Moorthi Temple (1781) is one of the oldest Hindu temples in Malaysia, built by the Chitty community.
quote: oldest existing/intact Hindu temple in Malaysia ... built by Thavinayagar Chitty ... in 1781.

claim: St Francis Xavier Church is the largest church in Melaka, built 1849, quieter than Christ Church.
quote: the largest and grandest church in Melaka ... built in 1849.

claim: Stadthuys/History & Ethnography Museum foreign adult entry is around RM10-20.
quote: For foreign visitors, the entrance fee is RM10 ... another source ... RM20 for foreigners.

claim: Official PERZIM museum ticket pricing for the Stadthuys museum complex.
quote: Museum Tickets - Melaka River Cruise Ticket.

claim: Menara Taming Sari is a revolving viewing tower open daily 09:00-22:00.
quote: Menara Taming Sari.

claim: Menara Taming Sari foreign adult daytime ticket ~RM26; open 09:00-22:00 last admission 21:00.
quote: RM26 for foreigners ... open daily from 9 am to 10 pm, with the last admission at 9 pm.

claim: Sultanate Palace Museum is a nail-free wooden replica of Sultan Mansur Shah's palace, foreign adult RM20, open 09:00-17:30 closed Mon.
quote: non-citizens pay RM 20 for adults ... wooden replica ... without the use of nails ... 09:00 to 17:30 ... closed on Mondays.

claim: PERZIM is the official Melaka Museums Corporation operating the heritage museum ticketing.
quote: Portal Rasmi Perbadanan Muzium Melaka.

claim: Riverside murals (the Nyonya Ladies mural near Jonker), Kampung Morten and Villa Sentosa (1920) are key sights along the river.
quote: massive street art murals ... Nyonya Ladies mural near Jonker Street ... Villa Sentosa ... built in 1920.

claim: Cheng Ho Cultural Museum covers Admiral Zheng He's links to Malacca on his original warehouse site.
quote: Cheng Ho Cultural Museum.

claim: Malacca has no airport; reach it from Kuala Lumpur, ~2-3 hours by bus.
quote: How to get from Kuala Lumpur to Melaka.

claim: StarMart Express runs KLIA to Melaka Sentral roughly hourly, ~RM35, ~2 hours.
quote: StarMart Express operates buses from KL International Airport T2 to Melaka Sentral hourly ... the journey taking 1h 55m.

claim: Kampung Kling Mosque (1748, rebuilt brick 1872) has a pagoda-style minaret and triple-tiered pyramidal roof instead of a dome.
quote: built by Indian Muslim traders in 1748 ... pyramidal roof replaces the conventional dome, and its pagoda-style minaret.

claim: Kampung Kling Mosque blends Sumatran, Chinese, Hindu and Malay styles with English and Portuguese tiles, on Harmony Street.
quote: Kampung Kling Mosque.

claim: Express coaches from KL run to Melaka Sentral, ~6 km from the heritage core (Chinatown).
